# Manual playbooks — the workflow without tool-specific features

Every playbook here is rendered from the same `core/` that produces the Claude Code skills, so it cannot drift from them.
Use it when your AI tool has no slash commands, subagents, inline commands or hooks — or when a person follows the workflow by hand.

## Playbooks

| Step | Playbook | Needs a person to start it |
|---|---|---|
| Check finished work before asking a human to approve | [check](skills/check.md) | no |
| Close a task that passed /check and was approved by the user | [done](skills/done.md) | yes |
| Urgent production fix procedure — record the symptom, find the cause, choose the approach, fix, release, then postmortem and feed back into the system | [hotfix](skills/hotfix.md) | yes |
| Open new work by capturing "why" before "what" | [intent](skills/intent.md) | no |
| Plan before touching code and save it as plan | [plan](skills/plan.md) | no |
| Build or refresh a click-through prototype from the committed canvas baseline (docs/design/canvas/* | [prototype](skills/prototype.md) | no |
| Release to uat or prd — run the milestone gate, build the image once, tag, prepare the release note and rollback plan | [release](skills/release.md) | yes |
| Spec a large feature as requirements, design, and tasks with an approval gate between each | [spec](skills/spec.md) | no |
| Pick a task from the backlog and work it | [task](skills/task.md) | no |
| Start building a UI component or screen by asking first, never designing on your own | [ui](skills/ui.md) | no |

Delegated roles: [code-reviewer](agents/code-reviewer.md) · [legacy-explorer](agents/legacy-explorer.md) · [test-writer](agents/test-writer.md)

## What still holds without session features

Hooks only exist inside a session of a tool that supports them. The gate (`node .claude/gate.js`, run by the pre-push hook and CI) is the same rules enforced outside any session. This table says which guarantees survive when there is no session tooling at all.

| Guarantee | Enforced by | Holds without session features | What that means |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| verify-before-merge | gate | yes | gate.js runs verify from the pre-push hook and CI, so it holds whatever tool wrote the code. |
| artifact-chain-consistent | gate | yes | docs-lint runs in the gate. |
| config-health | gate | yes | check-config runs in the gate. |
| dependency-and-secret-scan | gate | yes | audit and secrets steps of the gate, per auditMode/secretsMode. |
| evidence-artifacts-valid | gate | yes | requirement coverage, security baseline, supply chain, operational readiness, budgets and evals run in the gate when their files exist. |
| no-merge-into-main-by-ai | session-hook + host | **no** | guard-bash and the settings deny list stop it inside a Claude Code session only. Outside one, only branch protection on the git host stops it — which is the host's setting, not the kit's. |
| protected-files-not-hand-edited | session-hook | **no** | guard-edit blocks the edit inside a session. The gate cannot tell who changed a file, so a protected file edited by another tool is not caught; review is the only remaining check. |
| tests-untouched-on-bugfix-branch | session-hook | **no** | guard-edit only. Outside a session, review the diff of test files on fix/ and hotfix/ branches by hand. |
| no-hook-bypass | session-hook + host | **no** | guard-bash blocks --no-verify inside a session; outside, CI running the same gate is what catches a bypassed pre-push. |
